speaker: mathilda
text: You didn't turn around.
background: Her face is the same distance away as the far shore. I remember it nearer.
The prints between us stop short of where she is standing.

speaker: ophelia
text: I wanted to. Every step.
background: The prints behind me have filled, but the ones ahead still look like an invitation.

speaker: ophelia
text: You lied about the car.
background: The lie had a shape: two lanterns and no car.

speaker: mathilda
text: I didn't know what else would get you this far. You only ever walk toward a way out.

speaker: mathilda
text: This is where it happened. Do you remember which of us went through?
background: She waits for my answer with the patience of someone who has heard it before.

speaker: ophelia
text: You did. I pulled you out.
background: The old hole is narrower in this light. I remember a hand, not whose it was.

speaker: mathilda
text: That's how you tell it.

speaker: ophelia
text: I don't. I've never known.
background: The ice answers under my feet. I have no memory with it.

speaker: mathilda
text: One of us held very still, and one of us pulled. And after that you never let me go anywhere again.
background: Her hands stay at her sides. Mine remember holding on.
I have called that memory protection for so long I cannot separate the two.

speaker: ophelia
text: I was scared you'd go through again.
background: I held on so tightly that I stopped asking where she wanted to go.

speaker: ophelia
text: The card in the cellar said one cup.

speaker: mathilda
text: You only ever set out one for yourself. Mine you set out for me.

speaker: ophelia
text: I found your pack. Two cups.

speaker: mathilda
text: I packed for both of us. I always do. You just never came.

speaker: ophelia
text: You wrote on the post that it used my name.

speaker: mathilda
text: It did. And I answered. That's how I knew it wasn't lying.

speaker: mathilda
text: So you said go, then.
background: The word *then* leaves the door open behind us.

speaker: ophelia
text: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry I said it.
background: The apology comes with a breath I have been holding since the door.

speaker: ophelia
text: You were already going.
background: The doorway returns each time I tell this story. I cannot make it stay in the past.

speaker: mathilda
text: I was standing at the door, waiting for you to stop me.

speaker: mathilda
text: I know. I heard you. Every time you called, I heard you.
background: She says she heard me. The lake gives nothing back.

speaker: ophelia
text: Then why didn't you answer?
background: I have asked this question a hundred times. Now I have to let her answer.

speaker: mathilda
text: I did. You kept hearing yourself.

speaker: ophelia
text: It's my handwriting on your pages.
background: My hand knew the letters before I could read them.

speaker: mathilda
text: Then you've been writing to yourself the whole time. Read it back sometime. Out loud.

speaker: ophelia
text: The torn page said the prints just stop.
background: I know this sentence. I do not remember reading it.

speaker: mathilda
text: They stop where you stopped looking.

speaker: mathilda
text: I'm not the one who went out into the storm, Ophelia. I'm the part of you that wanted to.
background: I look for a seam in her coat, a place where the sentence could have started.
If she is only a memory, why does she always know the way out?

speaker: ophelia
text: Then what's under the sheet?

speaker: mathilda
text: A coat, buttoned to the throat. Nobody was ever in it.

speaker: ophelia
text: I don't care what you are. Come home.
background: Home is the word I reach for when I do not know how to ask.

speaker: mathilda
text: Ask me properly. Not "come home." Ask.
background: The question is small enough to carry across the ice without breaking it.
I have mistaken an answer for permission before. I wait for the rest.

speaker: ophelia
text: Walk back with me. Beside me. Not behind.
background: Beside me. The word lands differently than behind.

speaker: mathilda
text: Okay.

speaker: ophelia
text: Stay out here if you need to. I'll keep the lantern lit.
background: The lantern makes a promise I can keep from here.

speaker: mathilda
text: Then I'll always know where you are.

speaker: ophelia
text: I need a minute.

speaker: mathilda
text: The ice will hold. Take it.

speaker: mathilda
text: Still here. Still holding still.

speaker: ophelia
text: You left the door open for me. The page by the bed.

speaker: mathilda
text: For one of us. I never could decide which one needed rescuing.

speaker: ophelia
text: I saw you on the trail. You didn't say anything.

speaker: mathilda
text: Neither did you.

speaker: ophelia
text: Both cups are on the table. The kettle’s on.

speaker: mathilda
text: Both. You never set out both at once.
